main_text.p: lumitas, integritas: שְׁלָם לָךְ Pax tibi, Salve.
שְׁלֵימוּתָא, שְׁלֵימוּתָא, שְׁלֵמוּתָא Chald. Integritas, Perfectio.
אשְׁלָמוּתָא Ch. Perfectio, impletio, Exo.25.7.& 28.18. Esth.1.5.& aliter, אשְׁלַמְנוּתָא, Levit. 8.33. in Jon. Pl. אשְׁלָמוּתָא Ibidem v.34.
תּוּשְׁלְמָא Ch. Retributio, recompensatio. תּוּשְׁלְמוּתָא Ch. Idem, Deut.32.32. in Jon.
תִּשְׁלוּמֵי Chald. Idem: & adverbialiter, Pro, loco, vice, עַיִן תִּשְׁלוּמֵי עַיִן וְשֵׁן תִּשְׁלוּמֵי שֵׁן Oculus pro oculo, & dens pro dente, Levit. 24.20. in Jonath.
Syr. Perfectus, absolutus, 2. ad Timoth. 3. 16. emphat. ad Hebræos 9.11. Plur. Perfecti, Jac. 1. 4.
Syr. Proditor, prodens, tradens aliquē in alterius potestatem. Plur. Proditores, 2. ad Timoth. 3.4.
שְׁלִינוּנָא Ch. Mergus, avis, Hebr. שָׁלָךְ, Lev. 11.17. in Onk. In Jonath. scribitur ut duæ voces שְׁלִינוּנָא.

page.notes: Greek-style Syriac and Hebrew words are rendered approximately from the scan; the Syriac lines (marked by pointed letters) are only approximately reproduced and some vocalisation is uncertain. Syriac headwords in the early lines are partly illegible on the scan.
